I will also spread manure here since we keep cattle and every year I put whatever compost I have on my best plots. I will use improved maize seed for this plot because it is my main plot and I need a good harvest, but I will not buy pesticides or herbicides because they are too expensive for maize and we do not have insect problems here. This land is small enough that my family and I can manage all the work with our oxen, and the rains should be enough without irrigation.
